reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Ten Locales and Improved Placement
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the build UI in Provincia! Now supporting ten languages, our new localization feature ensures a smoother experience for all players. Additionally, we've enhanced placement feedback to clearly indicate why certain placements fail, and optimized day/night transitions to prevent any hitches during gameplay. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement

steam.title: Provincia Update: Ten Locales and Enhanced Gameplay
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce that Provincia now supports ten languages, making the game more accessible for players around the world! We've also improved the placement feedback system, allowing you to easily understand placement failures. Plus, our day/night transitions are now optimized for a smoother experience. Check out all the details on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
